'''Nuni''' was a member of the [[Hill people]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gala]]. In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], Nuni was tasked by [[Elan Tallah|Elan]], leader of the Hill people, to take all the children and elders to a safe shelter when the [[Royal guard (Gala)|royal guards]] [[Battle of Gala|attacked]] the Hill people's encampment.<ref name="MotC" />
